notes.content:
Ten Dates, sequel to the beloved classic to Five Dates is now available for pre-order! Meet your new crush by pre-ordering on Steam, Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch!


 Pre-order on Steam here
 Pre-order on Playstation here
 Pre-order on Xbox here
 Pre-order on Nintendo Switch here

The live-action FMV game will star Misha and Ryan, two millennial Londoners in search of their special someone at a speed dating event. 

Speed daters can witness how their choices can strengthen or weaken relationships with potential love matches. As Misha and Ryan attempt to charm five distinct personalities each, they’ll face daunting ice-breaker challenges, shocking revelations, and plenty of awkward moments. Long conversations and deep questions lead to a variety of different outcomes.

notes.title: To Skip or Not to Skip
notes.content:
Hello!

First and foremost we would like to thank you, everyone, who has been playing recently, we have enjoyed watching your playthroughs, reading your feedback and have been taking notes of all your suggestions.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1628130/view/3090038532608169285

One feature we recognise could have been explained better is the Skip function. To some, it may appear as if it's bugged or broken but the skip feature is only granted after your first playthrough of the game. It's a reward for your completion and to make it easier to fastrack past the scenes you've watched to unlock the hidden clues/stories or collect achievements you missed.

Be careful what you skip! Some scenes may look similar to ones you've already watched but they can most definitely end differently. There is more information and possible evidence up for grabs in the new scenes that will help you find the killer. Even some extra story information for each character at the end of the game.

We hope this helps and thank you again for playing! 

- Wales Interactive Team

What did you think of the game? Leave your reviews on the store page to support the game on Steam and help others decide if it's right for them.

notes.title: A Closer Inspection: Find the Poison, the Proof, the Killer
notes.content:
Find The Poison

Play the yearly family quiz and team-up with the members of your choice where you will secretly interrogate them via on-screen choices. Get familiar with the family, someone must still have the poison? It's a who's who of new and familiar FMV actors including Andy Buckley (The Office), Robbie Kay (Pinocchio), Al Weaver (The Complex) and Georgia Small (Five Dates, Bloodshore)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/336b352ac85901691ab05e86b68ae5c3ec59a9b8.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/ec348fdffe6a1e250e94f653192f63526d0908dc.gif

Find The Proof

Throughout the game you will collect evidence on each character, which you will use to determine who the killer is. At the end of each game round you will have a chance to review the evidence of the person you teamed up with. HINT: You can also review each character's evidence in the main menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/5c1745419787c3edc62475651a497cc2ed2274a6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/a3b2f687ff62a1d29ab34c44e61337e469e1e725.jpg

Find The Killer

So you think you know who poisoned Uncle Marcus? It's time to accuse them! As long as you've got enough evidence to support your accusation, at the end of the game you can accuse that member of the family. Regardless of whether you choose correctly or not, each character has their own story, their own secret, that will be discovered at the end of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580713/c0df7ba5f7a6218f1aac330ed4b96d8bdfcb8a7b.gif
